text:
maria: Kickoff: Gradual geozone rollout starting 2025-11-12 22:00 UTC. Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Plan slices 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Need capacity checks, pin rules, and rollback windows. ACKs please.

deploy-bot: Automated preflight: US capacity OK (12/16 GPUs allocatable). EU capacity constrained (6/12 allocatable) — recommend hold at 25% until warm pool +2. APAC quota partial (80%). Suggested deploy command: `/deploy start --regions us,eu,apac --slices 10,25,50,100 --pin prod-v2.1`.

liam: ACK. SRE_Tom, can you confirm EU warmup ETA? If <20m we can proceed to 25%.

sre_tom: Starting EU warmup now. Command: `ops warmup --region eu --count 2`. ETA ~15m if no throttles. Also enabling thermal headroom monitor and extra eviction margin.

anya: Add rollback trigger: if EU latency > 600ms sustained for 5m at 25% slice, auto-rollback EU to prod-v2.0. Also run the canary promptset before 50% to check quality regressions.

maria: Agreed. Pin rule for EU: pin to prod-v2.0 if CPU util > 75% OR p99 latency > 700ms for 3m. I'll add to release notes after we finish this thread.

deploy-bot: Rollout action: initiating US slice=10% at 1750001234. Smoke tests: PASS. Telemetry snapshot: p50=85ms, p95=220ms. Current US alloc: 12/16 GPUs.

liam: US metrics look stable. Plan to advance to 25% for US in 5m if no alerts.

sre_tom: EU warmup progressing, 2 instances booting. APAC: reserve quota at 80% — I requested a temporary bump from partner cloud, awaiting approval. If denied, APAC traffic will be routed via nearest healthy region as fallback.

anya: Also: add canary quality check job `evals run --suite canary-promptset --version prod-v2.1` and gate the 50% slice on it passing threshold.

maria: Sounds good. Final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: to ACK this plan and I'll run the deploy command.

liam: :thumbsup:

sre_tom: :thumbsup:

anya: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Next holdpoint scheduled in 5m. Reminder: to abort run `deploy-bot abort 1750001234`. Autopin fallback for EU configured -> prod-v2.0. Release note stub: "geozone gradual rollout; EU warmup required; autopin fallback set."
